recognizableFeatures: Broad stainless circular jacket with two raised annular waist bands and adjustable feet.
Open-center annular mould deck with three concentric rows of repeated rectangular pockets.
Several tall pneumatic filling, stick, and demould stations placed around the rotary deck.
Long elevated rectangular transfer shroud with an open multi-tier carrier path.
Separate stainless control cabinet with a cyan Runyu fascia, HMI, and pushbuttons.
External blue brine-pump motor, sanitary return pipe, valves, and pale pneumatic tubing.
